You see a giant shimmering pearl.
It weighs 0.80 oz.

    Notes

    This pearl can be found in 2 different colours: green and brown. Only those of the same colour can be stacked altogether. They have no known use, except for decoration. You have a chance to obtain one every 20 hours inside Sea Shells. 3 can be obtained through the Rise of Devovorga and 1 can be obtained through the Lightbearer Event.
